android.desc: Find the words for your next dating conversation. FlirtFix is an AI dating assistant that helps you write opening messages and replies using the context of a profile or chat. Upload a screenshot, choose your tone, and explore suggestions you can edit to sound like you. Start with a profile Turn details from a dating profile into ideas for a first message. Use a screenshot from apps such as Tinder, Hinge or Bumble to find a more personal way to break the ice. Keep the conversation going Upload a chat screenshot or add conversation text to get reply suggestions based on the exchange. Choose a playful, confident or sincere approach, then copy a suggestion and make it your own. Stay in control Review and edit the conversation text before generating. Use the blur tool to hide sensitive areas of your screenshot before uploading it. Save your conversations Sign in to keep reply threads in your archives, revisit suggestions and continue a conversation later. Get feedback from the community Share a post, join discussions and vote on whether a message is ready to send. Use FlirtFix in your language The app interface is available in English, Spanish, German, French and Portuguese. Free access includes a daily reply allowance. Premium offers additional access through a weekly subscription; the current price and applicable limits are shown in the app. Download FlirtFix and try a new approach to your next conversation.
